title: Rollback Surgeon: Traffic Fencing for Private VPC Runtime Rollouts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: implement a traffic-fencing + rollback orchestration pattern for Private (VPC) data-plane rollouts that minimizes customer-visible interruptions and enables surgical rollbacks when behavioral regressions are detected. This ticket covers the controller-level changes, Terraform/IaC hooks, synthetic and production health probes, and a small runbook to validate safe rollback procedures. The design is informed by recent outage postmortems and aims to reduce blast radius during model/runtime patches by offering fine-grained traffic fencing (tenant or slice level), short-circuit circuit-breakers, and an automated rollback surgeon that performs staged reversions with traffic hedging rather than blunt full-cluster rollbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Can fence traffic by tenant slice or VPC subnet via rollout policy flags in IaC and runtime controller
Terraform modules expose rollout fencing and probe config; apply plan does not require manual steps for enablement
Controller can detect health regressions (error rate, latency P99, KV cache miss surge) and trigger staged rollback for target slice without touching healthy slices
Synthetic probe suite shows <5s failover for fenced slice in 90% of simulated regressions
Playbook validated in staging: rollback surgeon completes staged revert and reconciles KV priming state with no leaked traffic to reverted instances
Comprehensive unit + integration tests covering Terraform plan changes, controller actions, and canary-to-rollback transition
Monitoring alerts and dashboard panels added to Console release monitoring for the rollout fencing feature
tasks: Design: finalize traffic-fencing API (rollout policy flags, slice selectors, priority levels)
IaC: add rollout_fence resource to private_vpc Terraform module with probe config and default thresholds
Controller: implement Rollback Surgeon state machine (determine scope, stagger revert, priming and drain)
Healthchecks: extend synthetic probe runner to include KV cache priming and cold-start latency scenarios
CI: add simulated regression tests in e2e harness that assert staged rollback semantics
Observability: dashboard panels for slice health, rollback events, and priming progress
Runbook: author step-by-step rollback surgeon runbook and post-rollback validation checklist
QA: schedule canary rehearsal in staging and one controlled rehearsal in preprod

notes: Trade-offs considered: aggressive fencing reduces blast radius but increases rollout duration. We chose staged fencing by slice with configurable concurrency limits.
Fallback: if priming reconciliation fails after two attempts, we escalate to manual intervention and open an incident with automated data capture.
Security: feature toggles default to disabled for new private deployments until security review completed.
Why unique: avoids full-cluster rollback by making rollbacks targeted, observable, and reversible while preserving KV cache correctness where possible.
